queries:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM expense
  WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_budget
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t
)
SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total,
       SUM(t.cnt) AS total_expenses,
       AVG(t.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess
FROM t, a
WHERE t.total > a.avg_total;
WITH t AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS cnt
    FROM budget b
    LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
),
a AS (
    SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t
)
SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total,
       SUM(t.cnt) AS expense_count,
       AVG(t.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess
FROM t, a
WHERE t.total > a.avg_total;
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY link_to_budget
),
avg_spent AS (
    SELECT AVG(spent) AS a FROM budget
)
SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total,
       SUM(t.cnt) AS expense_count,
       AVG(t.total - (SELECT a FROM avg_spent)) AS avg_excess
FROM totals t
WHERE t.total > (SELECT a FROM avg_spent);
SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total, SUM(cnt) AS total_expenses, AVG(total - (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)) AS avg_excess
FROM (
    SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY link_to_budget
)
WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
